Google Launches New Fitbit Edge Fitness Tracker

Google has launched the Fitbit Edge, a new fitness tracker featuring a color display and a replaceable battery. The device is priced at $180 and includes features such as ECG capability and a battery life of up to seven days. Forbes noted that while the technology is competitive, a couple of features are missing.
